scientific_limitations: Specific three-state primitive graph and strictly positive energy penalties.
Dominant spectral eigenvalue does not necessarily appear in every observable correlation.
Critical-window asymptotics fix the scaled detuning and are not uniformly asserted for diverging detuning.
Historical priority under alternate finite-state Markov-chain terminology remains a risk.
title: Exact positive-to-oscillatory relaxation transition in a three-state Gibbs shift
